title: CMYK proof
description: A printed citrus study separates into four angled screens as its color plates slip out of register.
useCase: Refine subtractive print texture through independent ink-screen alignment.
reducedMotion: The elapsed-time clock stops. Parameter controls immediately update the static composition.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1; a static CSS swatch appears if unavailable or after context loss. Original procedural still life; four screen approximation without ICC color management.
look: Cream paper with a red-orange citrus and green leaf rendered as coarse cyan, magenta, yellow and black halftone dots, with a dotted diagonal shadow.
motion: The citrus artwork rotates at 0.08 rad/s beneath four fixed, differently angled dot screens; the registration slider shifts the cyan, magenta and yellow plates apart.
adapt: All drawing is in the `FRAGMENT` shader: `artwork` is the procedural citrus (turning at `u_time*.08`), `ink` builds each angled dot screen, and `u_control` scales the plate offsets. Swap `artwork` for your own illustration or texture lookup; keep the context-loss and reduced-motion handling.
